This magic-infused greatsword was forged by smelting ore found in the Hebra Mountains' permafrost. Attack when the blade glows blue to expel freezing air.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 30 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Great Frostblade}} Great Frostblades are a [[Weapon]] forged with ore found in the permafrost of the [[Hebra Mountains]]. As a result, this is where they are commonly found, as well as in [[Hyrule Field]]. Their elemental nature is a hallmark of the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype, to which Great Frostblades belong.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} They are especially common around [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. When Great Frostblades glow blue, they can freeze any [[Enemy|Enemies]] that they are used against. They can also be equipped in cold areas to give [[Link]] one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. When they are used to attack [[Fire]]-related Enemies, such as [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]] and [[Fire Wizzrobe]]s, they will be defeated in a single swing.{{Cite|{{Big|Elemental Weaknesses}}
If you use an icy attack against a fiery enemy, you may defeat it in one hit.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} Great Frostblades are made of metal, which means they attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They also cannot be burned by [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]], but they sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. To rectify this, they can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_034" |Life = 40 |Power = 30 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 2000 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 500 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 20.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 11 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 15 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 16 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 30 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 150 |BuyingPrice = 150 }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Frostblade * Frostspear * Magic Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Claymores, Magic Gear, Swords, Weapons |items= BotW }} [[de:Eis-Großschwert]]
